    "According to NCERT Accountancy Class XII, when Profit and Loss Account shows a credit balance (net profit), it is transferred by debiting Profit and Loss A/c and crediting Profit and Loss Appropriation A/c."
  ],

    {
      "condition": "Profit and Loss Account has a credit balance (net profit) at the end of the year.",
      "status": "explicit",
      "alters_key_if_changed": true,
      "convention_evidence_ids": []
    },
    {
      "condition": "Standard journal entry convention for closing net profit to Profit and Loss Appropriation Account.",
      "status": "convention",

      "convention_evidence_ids": []
    },
    {
      "option": "C",
      "strongest_reading": "This entry erroneously treats Interest on Capital as an account directly debited to Profit and Loss Account.",
      "correct_under_reading": false,
      "reading_status": "contradicts_stem",
      "convention_evidence_ids": []
    },
    {
      "option": "D",
      "strongest_reading": "This entry represents the distribution of divisible profits to partners' capital accounts, not the transfer from Profit and Loss Account.",
      "correct_under_reading": false,

    }
  ],

  "option_resolution": [
    {
      "option": "A",
      "status": "contradicted",
      "false_part": "Profit and Loss Appropriation A/c Dr. To Profit and Loss A/c",
      "premise_source": "excerpt",
      "evidence_id": "E1.2",
      "premise_quote": "(a) If Profit and Loss Account shows a credit balance (net profit):\nProfit and Loss A/c Dr.\nTo Profit and Loss Appropriation A/c",
      "reason": "This entry is used for net loss, not credit balance net profit."
    },
    {
      "option": "B",
      "status": "supported",
      "false_part": "",
      "premise_source": "excerpt",
      "evidence_id": "E1.2",
      "premise_quote": "(a) If Profit and Loss Account shows a credit balance (net profit):\nProfit and Loss A/c Dr.\nTo Profit and Loss Appropriation A/c",

    },
    {
      "option": "C",

      "premise_source": "excerpt",
      "evidence_id": "E1.2",
      "premise_quote": "To Profit and Loss Appropriation A/c",
      "reason": "Transfer is made to Profit and Loss Appropriation Account, not Interest on Capital."
    },
    {
      "option": "D",
      "status": "contradicted",
      "false_part": "Profit and Loss Appropriation A/c Dr. To Partners' Capital A/c",
      "premise_source": "excerpt",
